title: DeepSeek OpenRouter pilot — deterministic 20-case microtask corpus
description: Fixed candidate set of 20 small, independent, no-emulator microtasks drawn from safe shared-harness pure unit surfaces and documentation-only checks. Used by later baseline capture (rr-zmfh.3) and the 20-query DeepSeek pilot (rr-zmfh.4). This file alone does not claim any pilot pass.

notes: Exclude active solver paths (adventure, benchmark), game movement lanes, ROMs, external services, user data, and dirty artifact trees.
owned_paths are the exclusive writable ownership surface for conflict scheduling.
Acceptance commands are single-process local checks only.

cases.title: Named controller action vectors
cases.scope: Preserve the pure retro_harness.actions named-button API (SNES/NES vectors, idle, multi-button) and its focused unit tests.
cases.expected_observable: pytest exits 0; all tests in retro_harness/tests/test_actions.py pass

rubric.pass: Acceptance command exits 0 with zero failures/errors; owned_paths stay pure (no ROM/emulator imports introduced).
rubric.fail: Non-zero exit, collection/import error, or owned_paths gain emulator/ROM/external-service dependencies.
